extDescription.message: Fills forms with realistic test data based on each field's label and name. Italian and English.

cmdFillPage.message: Fill all fields on the page

cmdClearPage.message: Clear all fields on the page

menuFillPage.message: Fill all fields on this page

popupNoIdentity.message: Fill a page to generate an identity.

popupCopyHint.message: Click a value to copy it

optLocaleHelp.message: "Auto" uses the page language (lang attribute, domain and visible text).

optFallback.message: When the language can't be detected

optPasswordHelp.message: Leave empty to generate a strong random password (shown in the popup).

optKeepIdentity.message: Keep the same identity between fills (multi-step forms)

optOverwrite.message: Overwrite fields that already have a value

optIncludeHidden.message: Also fill invisible fields (may trigger honeypots)

optAttachFiles.message: Attach a sample file to file inputs (PNG/JPG/GIF/PDF/TXT… based on "accept")

optHighlight.message: Highlight filled fields (green = recognised, orange = generic, blue = custom rule)

optDebug.message: Log detected field types to the page console

optRulesHelp.message: One rule per line: regex = value. The regex is tested (case-insensitive) against the field's label, name, id and placeholder. Values can use {firstName} {lastName} {fullName} {email} {phone} {username} {password} {city} {cap} {street} {company} {cf} {piva} {iban} {today} {n} {rand}. Use {skip} to leave a field alone, true/false for checkboxes. Lines starting with # are comments.

optResetConfirm.message: Reset all options to their defaults?

optShortcutsHelp.message: Alt+Shift+F fills the page, Alt+Shift+E fills the focused form. Change them in chrome://extensions/shortcuts (Firefox: Add-ons → ⚙ → Manage Extension Shortcuts).

optSimulateTyping.message: Simulate real typing (key events per character) for masked or guarded inputs, e.g. banking sites. Fields that reject a direct value are always retried this way.
